title: Video creation from a prompt in Microsoft Clipchamp: now in Video Hub, with an upgraded experience coming
summary: Microsoft Clipchamp's prompt-to-video feature is now in Video Hub. By February 2027, an upgraded version with better quality and fixes will replace it, available to current subscribers. Existing projects remain accessible, no admin action is needed, and users can refer to the provided support article.
body:
[What and Why:]

Creating a video from a text prompt in Clipchamp is now available in Video Hub. By the end of February 2027, we'll replace this experience with an upgraded version that does the same things, produces higher-quality videos and fixes known issues. The upgraded experience will be available to the same users as part of their existing subscription.

[Rollout Schedule:]

General Availability (Worldwide): Now: prompt-to-video is available in Video Hub.

By the end of February 2027: the upgraded experience replaces the current one. We'll publish an update to this post with confirmed dates.

[Impact on Your Organization:]

Users create videos from a prompt in Video Hub. See instructions here, How to create video with Copilot

When the upgraded experience arrives, users get the same capabilities with better video quality.

Existing content stays where it is. Video projects and exported MP4 files remain in users' OneDrive or SharePoint, and users can keep opening, editing and exporting them in Clipchamp.

All other Clipchamp features and admin settings stay the same.

[Action Required/Recommendations:]

No admin action is needed. You might want to share the support article above and tell users that prompt-to-video is in Video Hub, and update any internal training or help content to match.

[Compliance considerations:]

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.
